defects.description: Grammatically incorrect title; literal translation of 'Network Servers'. Should be 'Сетевые серверы'.
Case mismatch; the term should be in the genitive case to match the list of servers.
In the context of DNS zone files, 'Origin' is a technical term referring to the base domain; 'Начало' is an inaccurate general translation.
Grammatically incorrect construction; the glossary term is inserted in the nominative case where the genitive case is required.
Case mismatch; the term should be in the instrumental case ('подчиненным сервером') following the word 'называемый'.
Literal translation of the impersonal pronoun 'One', which is grammatically incorrect and unnatural in Russian.
